repos.description: Qlib is an AI-oriented Quant investment platform that aims to use AI tech to empower Quant Research, from exploring ideas to implementing productions. Qlib supports diverse ML modeling paradigms, including supervised learning, market dynamics modeling, and RL, and is now equipped with https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent to automate R&D process.
repos.summary_zh: Qlib是微软开源的AI驱动量化投资平台，旨在用AI技术赋能量化研究全流程。平台支持监督学习、强化学习等多种机器学习范式，并集成RD-Agent实现因子挖掘与模型优化的自动化研发。适用于从策略构思到生产部署的全场景，提供跨平台支持，助力量化投资智能化升级。
repos.summary_en: Qlib is Microsoft's open-source AI-powered quantitative investment platform designed to empower the entire quant research workflow with AI technology. The platform supports diverse ML paradigms including supervised learning, market dynamics modeling, and reinforcement learning. It integrates RD-Agent, an LLM-based autonomous framework that automates factor mining and model optimization. Suitable for scenarios ranging from strategy ideation to production deployment, Qlib offers cross-platform support and accelerates intelligent transformation in quantitative investing.

repos.summary_zh: Vibe-Trading 是港大开源的个人AI交易代理系统，通过单一命令赋予智能体完整交易能力。采用Python 3.11+与FastAPI后端、React 19前端，支持MCP协议实现模型交互。核心亮点包括Swarm集群容错恢复、影子账户模拟交易、Rich交互式CLI。提供API与MCP服务，支持实时任务协调与状态管理，为量化交易提供开箱即用的AI解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is HKU's open-source personal AI trading agent system that empowers agents with comprehensive trading capabilities through a single command. Built with Python 3.11+ and FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend, it supports MCP for model context interaction. Key features include Swarm cluster fault tolerance recovery, shadow account simulation, Rich interactive CLI, and automated operations. It provides API and MCP services, enabling real-time task coordination and state management for quantitative trading with out-of-the-box AI solutions.

repos.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
repos.summary_zh: Sure 是一款开源个人理财与财富管理应用，由社区维护的 Maybe Finance 分支发展而来。支持 Docker 自托管，提供浏览器、macOS 桌面、移动端、API 及 LLM 代理等多种客户端，内置 AI 助手解答财务问题，帮助用户全面掌控现金流、净资产与消费支出。
repos.summary_en: Sure is an open-source personal finance and wealth management app, a community-maintained fork of Maybe Finance. It supports Docker self-hosting and offers multiple clients including browser, macOS desktop, mobile, API, and LLM agents. An AI assistant answers financial questions, helping users track cashflow, net worth, and spending.

repos.description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
repos.summary_zh: AutoHedge 是一个基于群体智能的多代理AI系统，可自动化构建对冲基金。系统采用Director、Quant、Risk Manager、Execution四层代理架构，实现从市场分析、策略生成到风险控制和交易执行的全流程自主化。目前支持Solana链上全自动交易，采用风险优先设计，提供结构化输出和企业级日志，适用于机构级量化交易场景。
repos.summary_en: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous hedge fund platform powered by swarm intelligence and multi-agent AI systems. It orchestrates specialized agents for market analysis, strategy generation, risk management, and trade execution in a risk-first pipeline. Currently supporting full autonomous trading on Solana, it features structured JSON outputs, comprehensive logging, and modular architecture for institutional-grade quantitative trading with minimal human intervention.

repos.description: Beancount: Double-Entry Accounting from Text Files.
repos.summary_zh: Beancount 是一种基于文本的复式记账领域特定语言，将会计逻辑代码化。通过纯文本文件定义交易记录，支持自动化报告生成和 Web 界面展示，适用于个人理财与中小企业记账。v3 版本保持极简主义设计，强调持久性与可编程性，为开发者提供灵活的财务管理工具。
repos.summary_en: Beancount is a text-based domain-specific language for double-entry bookkeeping that codifies accounting logic into plain text files. It enables automated report generation and provides a web interface for visualization. Designed for personal finance and small business accounting, Beancount emphasizes minimalism, durability, and programmability. The current stable v3 version offers developers a flexible, scriptable financial management tool that treats accounting as code, ensuring long-term data portability and extensibility.

repos.description: QuantMind is an open source agent-native knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance.
repos.summary_zh: QuantMind是面向量化金融的智能知识提取与检索框架，将论文、新闻、报告等非结构化内容转化为语义知识图谱。采用两阶段架构：提取阶段通过多模态解析、领域特定LLM和智能代理实现结构化、标签化与去重；检索阶段支持嵌入向量、RAG、多跳推理等场景。适用于对冲基金、机构投资者快速探索因子策略与市场洞见，提升研究效率并挖掘Alpha。获NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop接受。
repos.summary_en: QuantMind is an intelligent knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance. It transforms unstructured content such as papers, news, reports, and SEC filings into a semantic knowledge graph. Built on a decoupled two-stage architecture, the extraction stage uses multi-modal parsing, domain-specific LLMs, tagging, and agentic workflows for structuring and deduplication; the retrieval stage enables embeddings, RAG, DeepResearch multi-hop reasoning, and knowledge-aware generation. Ideal for hedge funds and research teams to accelerate factor and risk model discovery. Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop.

repos.description: Portable project memory across Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, plus token accounting measured from harness transcripts. Local file I/O, no API calls, no telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: OpenWolf 是 Claude Code 的开源中间件，通过 6 个隐形 hook 脚本为其提供'第二大脑'。它构建项目文件索引、学习记忆和 token 账本，在读取文件前提供上下文信息，阻止重复读取，自动记录偏好与错误。实测可减少 80% token 消耗，平均节省 65.8%，且无需改变现有工作流。
repos.summary_en: OpenWolf is an open-source middleware that acts as a 'second brain' for Claude Code, delivering sharper context and dramatically reducing token usage. Through 6 invisible hook scripts, it builds project file indexes with token estimates, accumulates learning memory from corrections, and maintains a comprehensive token ledger. By providing file context before reads, blocking duplicate accesses within sessions, and auto-documenting preferences and mistakes, it achieves up to 80% token reduction (averaging 65.8% across 132+ real-world sessions) with zero workflow changes for developers.

repos.description: Free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher for web scraping and multi-accounting. By the ShardX team (formerly ProxyShard). Engine-level fingerprint spoofing in Chromium 158 (WebGL / WebGPU / Client Hints / fonts / TLS), 220+ device profiles bundled, stable QUIC + WebRTC over SOCKS5.
repos.summary_zh: ShardX 是开源反检测浏览器启动器，基于修改版 Chromium 152 引擎实现多层指纹伪装，内置 220+ 设备配置，支持 SOCKS5 代理下 QUIC/WebRTC，提供多语言 SDK 与 MCP 服务，适用于网页爬虫与多账号管理。
repos.summary_en: ShardX is a free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher built on a patched Chromium 152 engine with deep fingerprint spoofing across WebGL, WebGPU, Client Hints, fonts, and TLS layers. It bundles 220+ device profiles, supports stable QUIC and WebRTC over SOCKS5 proxies, and provides multi-language SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Rust along with a local API and MCP server. Designed by the ProxyShard team, it is ideal for web scraping and multi-account management workflows at scale.
